page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance. The lack of integrated local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on compute and network throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8i.12xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute cores relative to memory, making it a viable option for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed compute tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, allocating 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage for data persistence. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Designed for compute-heavy tasks, the ecs.c8i.12xlarge is structured for workloads such as batch processing, web serving, and compilation pipelines where dedicated CPU performance is prioritized over large memory allocations or local storage.
